title: The contract lint flags an _answers.md Conclusion line that asserts what the same entry's Open line marks unconfirmed
goal: SP-23m5etrf retrospective: the goal research's AlmaLinux CIS entry in kb/public/_answers.md concluded 'not with the upstream repository's RHEL data stream' (line 3354) while its Open line (3355) and security/linux-cis-ssg-openscap.md:38 [UNK] leave that applicability unconfirmed (parked as BG-vi5dw4zd); the review caught it, no gate did. The kb-research skill tells the worker to word a DER conclusion no stronger than its Open line, and the lint warns of a Conclusion that negates or asserts a term its entry's Open line lists.

run:
import os, sys, subprocess, tempfile
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); r = os.path.join(d, "zz"); os.makedirs(os.path.join(r, "dom"))
def w(p, t):
    open(os.path.join(r, p), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(t)
w("_root.md", "---
root: zz
id_prefix: ZZ
visibility: internal
description: planted
---

# zz
")
w("_sources.csv", "id,url,title,publisher,licence,reuse,retrieved_utc,version_or_date,artifact_sha256,used_in,superseded_by
ZZ-aaaaaaaa,https://example.com/a,A,Example,CC,summary,2026-10-16,,,,
")
HEAD = "---
topic: dom/a
priority: P3
applies_to: [x]
retrieved_utc: 2026-10-16
sources: [ZZ-aaaaaaaa]
status: complete
---

# A

## Summary
S.

## Facts
"
TAIL = "
## Reference
R.

## Examples

"

w("dom/a.md", HEAD + "- A fact. [DOC ZZ-aaaaaaaa]
" + TAIL)
w("_answers.md", "# Answers

## QK-planted-overreach. Does the vendor image scan with the RHEL data stream?
- The vendor ships its own package. [DOC ZZ-aaaaaaaa]
- Conclusion: the vendor image is not scanned with the upstream repository RHEL data stream. [DER ZZ-aaaaaaaa: package list]
- Open: whether the RHEL data stream evaluates on the vendor image. [UNK]
- See dom/a.md.

_Agent: kb-research_

- The tool prints a banner at start. [DOC ZZ-aaaaaaaa]
- Conclusion: the tool prints a banner at start, since the page says so. [DER ZZ-aaaaaaaa: banner]
- Open: the exact version of the vendor package. [UNK]
- See dom/a.md.

_Agent: kb-research_
")

env = dict(os.environ, KB_ROOTS=r)
b = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/build_index.py", "--root", "zz"], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
assert b.returncode == 0, b.stderr
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, ".claude/skills/kb-verify/lint.py", "zz"], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(p.stdout.strip())

mine = [l for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith("WARN") and "_answers.md" in l]
ok = len(mine) == 1 and ("QK-planted-overreach" in mine[0] or "_answers.md:5" in mine[0])
print("lint warns of the overreaching Conclusion only:", ok)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
